mute_lead:
MOV AL, [0x10AA]   ; read the mute byte
OR AL, 0b00100     ; switch on the lead's flag
MOV [0x10AA], AL   ; write it back
mute_bass_hats:
MOV AL, [0x10AA]   ; read the mute byte
OR AL, 0b11000     ; switch on the bass and hi-hat flags
MOV [0x10AA], AL   ; write it back
unmute_lead:
MOV AL, [0x10AA]   ; read the mute byte
AND AL, 0b11011    ; switch off the lead's flag
MOV [0x10AA], AL   ; write it back
solo_bass:
MOV AL, [0x10AA]   ; read the mute byte
OR AL, 0b11111     ; mute every voice
AND AL, 0b10111    ; then unmute the bass
MOV [0x10AA], AL   ; write it back
toggle_snare:
MOV AL, [0x10AA]   ; read the mute byte
MOV BL, AL         ; a copy to test
AND BL, 0b00010    ; keep only the snare's flag
CMP BL, 0
JE mute            ; 0: the snare is playing, so mute it
AND AL, 0b11101    ; 1: it is muted, so unmute it
JMP done
mute:
OR AL, 0b00010
done:
MOV [0x10AA], AL   ; write it back
